AVIATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #18
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Flight Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Flight Safety.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Flight Safety.

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Monitor
   B. Speaker
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

8. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team

9. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
